headline: Agent4Sci reports benchmark-specific gains on long-horizon ML-for-science tasks
summary: Agent4Sci introduces a long-horizon testbed covering 20 ML-for-science benchmarks, 25 tasks and 11 domains. The authors report that frontier agents improve task metrics across the benchmark suite; their abstract gives mean relative improvement of 10.4% for Claude Opus, with the larger gains attributed mostly to ML-engineering interventions rather than new research insight. Optional task-specific skills raise the reported mean for Claude Opus from 10.4% to 20.1% and for Codex from 4.4% to 8.1%. These are paper-reported benchmark outcomes, not an independent reproduction or evidence of general autonomous scientific discovery.
